raw:
Here are the 100 experiments. They come in five groups of 20. Within each group one edit is fixed, and I vary one other edge of the parent at a time across four ops, so any change in the edit's effect can be attributed to that edge.

- **Group 1:** edit edge 3 to skip_connect on an all-1x1 base.
- **Group 2:** edit edge 5 to 3x3 conv on an all-1x1 base.
- **Group 3:** edit edge 0 to none on an all-3x3 base.
- **Group 4:** edit edge 2 to skip_connect on an all-3x3 base.
- **Group 5:** edit edge 1 to avg_pool on a base of 1x1 convs with a 3x3 conv on edge 1.

I have not run any of these, so there are no results yet.
